title: Day Trips to Charleston#7 See Ft Sumter,CarriageTour,Lunch & more
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for travelers under age 4
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We have packaged our tour in such a way that you will experience Charleston much better and less expensive than if you drove to Charleston from Myrtle Beach and attempted to tour Charleston on your own. 
This package includes everything below: 
- Round trip transportation to Charleston from Myrtle Beach aboard our bus
- Horse drawn Carriage Tour of Charleston's Historic District
- Shopping Time at the City Market
- Boat Tour of Charleston Harbor
- Lunch on the Boat Tour
- See stunning views of Fort Sumter
- Tour of Boone Hall Plantation
